stepTitle: In the following blank, write a RegEx pattern that only matches words that contain the substring "cat" and does not contain any uppercase letters or space characters.
stepBody:
Aneesh decides to do the following RegEx exercises before processing feedback.
Fill in the blank with only the RegEx pattern; do not make your solution a raw string (a raw string is in the format $$`r"___"`)$$.
Match all of these below (pattern MUST match): cats, concatenate, 10cats10
Match none of these below (pattern must NOT match): Cat, CA Tacoma, CATcatCAT
